items.title: Q11 Q4(d): new speeds of the astronauts

mid.hint: Write the total angular momentum L: two astronauts, each with mass m, speed v, distance r from the center.

mid.tex: m v_1 r_1 = m v_2 r_2
mid.hint: Set angular momentum before (speed v_1, radius r_1) equal to after (v_2, r_2); solve for the new speed v_2.

items.title: Q11 Q1(c): acceleration of the counterweight

mid.hint: The torque τ on the wheel is the hanging weight, mass m times g, times the wheel radius R.
Total angular momentum L: the hanging mass m (speed v, radius R) plus the wheel (mass M) turning at v/R.
Set torque τ equal to the change in L over time Δt; the change in speed Δv over Δt is the acceleration a.

items.title: Q11 Q5: minimum ball speed to swing over the top

mid.hint: Before the hit, the ball's angular momentum L is its mass m times its speed v times the rod length ℓ.
After the ball sticks, the moment of inertia I adds the rod (mass M, length ℓ) and the ball (mass m at the end).
Over the top, the rod's center (mass M) rises ℓ and the ball (mass m) rises 2ℓ: the gain in potential energy ΔPE.
